base_method: full-history ReAct; raw observations retained, dispatcher interventions also retained
changes: persistent terminal action and observation-derived recipe/access preparation
receding short action paths rechecked after each observation
transitive demand rejects surplus ingredient crafting
explicit test id, required preconditions and predicted postconditions; no action-string matching or acceptance-as-proof
same-state action and unchanged-inspection veto applies to every dispatch source
veto causes and proposed/executed distinction retained in full history
ingredient listing correctly typed; object location freshness and visibility tracked
no arbitrary inspection fallback; explicit algorithm-stalled early stop if a correction yields no admissible candidate
no_access_during_decisions: game-specific preloaded recipes, named objects, maps or answers

evaluation: dependency preparations and actual product/equipment/write effects
test preconditions and predicted versus observed effects
repeated-state and inspection vetoes including dispatcher-caused loops
API tokens, repair/controller call counts, transport failures
all early exits recorded as incomplete trajectories, never reclassified as success
limits: same games used for development and evaluation; not held-out generalization evidence
one trajectory per method/game; no statistical significance or guarantee of higher score
observed quantities/access models remain partial and can be invalidated by changing world rules
zero admissible candidate after one correction is an explicit method failure; no automatic outcome-selected rerun
